judgment.notes: N001 applies to u0 and every smooth truncation in the same real mean-zero H^gamma ball. Since gamma>0, both initial L^2 norms are at most R, so B0=2R>0 is valid. N007 applies at the fixed positive tau=T/L to every mean-zero iterate. N011 applies to each truncation with the same C,tau0, since all its datum and step conditions hold. N006 unitarity at s=0 and N007 endpoint matching apply to the smooth trajectories. There are no E/M applications.

Symmetric Fourier truncation is smooth, preserves reality/mean and contracts the H^gamma norm; its weighted-square tail tends to zero. N001 therefore gives uniform-in-time L^2 convergence of the exact solutions. Continuity of Psi_tau gives convergence of each numerical iterate by induction, and finiteness of the fixed grid gives F002. The triangle inequality bounds the limiting grid error by the smooth error plus the two vanishing comparison errors, retaining C*tau^gamma. The limit solution's existence, uniqueness and distributional meaning come from N001, rather than an unsupported passage through the PDE. BG001-BG003 detail the routine completions.
